Data & Backups

Storage notice: All data is saved in this browser's LocalStorage on this device only. It is not cloud-synced and will not appear on other computers or browsers. Clearing browser data will erase the tournament. Export a JSON backup regularly. The organizer PIN is a basic convenience lock, not real security.
